fields.title: Botswana ministry tender record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _ministry/_source/_scrapedAt (plus _error/_errorDetail on failures). Field set differs by ministry -- 'finance' records carry RSS-feed fields, 'health' records carry HTML-table fields.

_ministry.title: Ministry
_ministry.description: Which ministry source produced this record: finance or health.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-mof-procurement-rss (Ministry of Finance), S2-moh-tenders-table (Ministry of Health), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed fetches -- blocked_or_transient.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

article_url.title: Article URL (Ministry of Finance)
article_url.description: The Ministry of Finance article page wrapping this notice -- in practice carries no text beyond the PDF link already captured in pdf_url.

category.title: Category (Ministry of Finance)
category.description: Upstream's own RSS category tag -- always "Procurement" for this feed.

pub_date.title: Published date, raw (Ministry of Finance)
pub_date.description: Upstream's own RFC-822 pubDate string, e.g. "Thu, 03 Oct 2024 23:08:44 +0200".

published_date.title: Published date, ISO UTC (Ministry of Finance)
published_date.description: pub_date parsed into UTC ISO 8601, or null if it could not be parsed (pub_date is always kept as a fallback).

pdf_url.title: Tender document PDF URL
pdf_url.description: Direct link to the tender/notice PDF document, present on both ministries' records where available.

attachment_title.title: Attachment link text (Ministry of Finance)
attachment_title.description: The link text of the embedded PDF anchor -- usually identical to title, occasionally with minor casing/spacing differences upstream itself introduced.

tender_ref.title: Tender reference number (Ministry of Health)
tender_ref.description: The ministry's own tender reference code, e.g. "MTC\MOHW\CLS\SER/10511/0707/2017".

closing_date.title: Closing date (Ministry of Health)
closing_date.description: Bid submission closing date as shown on the page, e.g. "31 August 2017" -- free text, not normalized (upstream does not provide a machine-readable date).

adjudication_decisions_url.title: Adjudication decisions URL (Ministry of Health)
adjudication_decisions_url.description: A page-level reference link to "MOH-MTC Tender Adjudication Decisions" on ppadb.co.bw -- passed through as raw data but NOT fetched by this actor; that domain family timed out on every connection attempt during recon (same family as the central PPRA portal skipped elsewhere in this collection).
